description: Rows that must not inform calibration metrics. Rows remain in the ledger as immutable audit history; this file only marks them ineligible for win-rate and timing aggregates. METADATA ONLY - contains no OHLCV values and no secrets.

structural_rule.predicate: NOT (0 < stop < entry < target), or any of entry/stop/target non-finite
structural_rule.detail: Derived from the stored row alone: no external data, no threshold. Mirrors the scanner emission gate shipped 2026-08-08, so a row today's scanner would refuse cannot inform calibration.

provenance_rule.detail: Explicit key list. Each key is individually evidenced against an archived contemporaneous OHLCV snapshot. NOT inferred from any stop-distance threshold - no such threshold is defensible.
